action: The knight does a game walk cycle in side view, like a walk on a treadmill. The knight takes two equal steps, one with each leg. Each foot swings forward low above the ground, lands on the heel in front of the body, then slides back below the body. The body moves up and down a little with each step. The knees stay low. The arms move only a little. The sword stays level and points forward, and the shield stays in front of the body.

beats.pose: the far leg swings forward past the near leg and lands in front, while the near foot slides back behind the body
the near leg swings forward past the far leg and lands in front, while the far foot slides back

keep: The red tabard keeps its torn hem with pointed tatters in every frame.
The shield keeps its gold eagle on a black field.
